structured.answer: After 8 years, with the page's example of 500 ₪ a month and 7% a year, I'd have about 68,853 ₪ ("נשאר בידיים"). For 4 years the calculator gives no number for the self-employed, only that you pay tax if you take it out before 6 years, so I'd ask you or an accountant.

stuck.why: There was only an orange note "לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב למשיכה לפני 6 שנים" and one number, 25,725, on a dotted bar for a securities account (ניירות ערך), not the fund. I wasn't sure if that was meant as my answer.
Many numbers and colours together, so it took a while to find which one is what I'd have (the white bar "נשאר בידיים").
